## Gramstax.hookBeforeRoute() method

Hook called before routing an update.

**Signature:**

```typescript
/** @virtual */
hookBeforeRoute(ctx: ICtx, listenerName: string): Promise<boolean>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;boolean&gt;

True to continue routing, false to abort.

## Remarks

Override this method to add pre-routing logic like authentication, rate limiting, or logging.

## Example


```typescript
async hookBeforeRoute(ctx: Ctx, listenerName: string) {
  if (ctx.userId === blockedUserId) {
    return false // Block this user
  }
  return true
}
```
